question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Maintains pneumatic control systems”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains renewable energy generating and energy storage systems
Installs and maintains HVAC electrical components
Installs and maintains pneumatic and hydraulic control systems
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places F-31.02 under F-31: Installs and maintains pneumatic and hydraulic control systems.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica F-31.02 dentro de F-31: Installs and maintains pneumatic and hydraulic control systems.

question_en: A 480 V circuit has 24 Ω resistance. What current flows?
explanation_es: I = E/R = 20 A.

question_en: A load uses 12 A at 240 V with PF 0.8. What real power is approximately used?
explanation_es: P = E × I × FP = 2304 W.

question_en: A waveform has 170 V RMS. Approximately what is its peak value?
explanation_en: Peak = RMS × √2 ≈ 240 V.
explanation_es: Pico = RMS × √2 ≈ 240 V.
